questions.prompt: What are custom directives best used for?

options.text: Reusing whole UI sections with state
Reusable low-level DOM behavior on elements (focus, click-outside, tooltips)

questions.explanation: Directives apply low-level, element-level DOM behavior. Whole-UI reuse belongs to components; reusable logic to composables.

questions.prompt: In <script setup>, how do you make a local directive usable in the template?

options.text: Name a variable vSomething; it becomes usable as v-something
Register it in a directives: option

questions.explanation: A <script setup> variable named vName is automatically exposed to the template as v-name.

questions.prompt: What does a directive's binding object contain?

options.text: The value, the arg (after the colon), and the modifiers (after dots)

questions.explanation: The binding carries value, arg, and modifiers; the hook also receives the element (el) itself.

questions.prompt: You install a plugin on the app with app.______(plugin, options). (one word/method)
questions.explanation: app.use(plugin, options) runs the plugin's install(app, options) — the same mechanism used for Vue Router and Pinia.

questions.prompt: A directive adds a document event listener in mounted. Why must it also define unmounted?

options.text: To remove the listener when the element is destroyed, preventing memory leaks

questions.explanation: Listeners added in mounted must be removed in unmounted; otherwise they leak memory and keep firing after the element is gone.

options.text: An object with an install(app, options) method (or a function) that performs app-wide setup

questions.explanation: A plugin packages app-wide setup — registering global components/directives, providing values, adding globalProperties — and is applied with app.use.
